verdict.rationale: Missive's own docs describe a Custom MCP feature for its AI assistant. You can connect any MCP-compatible server by entering a name and server URL, with none, bearer-token or OAuth 2.0 authentication (including custom scopes), and ready-made MCP integrations ship for Notion, Linear and Attio. Missive's separate MCP server, which lets external AIs act on Missive, is a different role and is not credited here. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration that the assistant reliably invokes the connected servers' tools.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can plug MCP servers into this product so it can use their tools

citations.quote: With custom MCP, you can connect any MCP-compatible server to Missive's AI assistant and let AI interact with your internal systems, proprietary data, or homegrown tools.
Add "Custom MCP" and enter a name and your server URL. Choose an authentication method and click Add
Choose an authentication method (none, bearer token, or OAuth 2.0, with custom scopes if your provider needs them) and click Add
Missive ships with ready-to-use MCP integrations for Notion, Linear, and Attio, plus AI automation platforms like Lindy.ai.
